title: From infinity and freedom from every composition
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): SIXTH, plus this ye most evident belonging toward all is, from God's infinite perfection. SEVENTH, that God from every composition whatsoever free is. For whatever composite is more imperfect than that which simple is; plus an infinite being composition does not suffer.
pass_b_english: SIXTH, and this is the most evident of all, from God's infinite perfection. SEVENTH, that God is free from every composition whatsoever. For whatever is composite is more imperfect than that which is simple; and an infinite being does not suffer composition.
source_text: SEXTO, id est omnium evidentissimum ab infinita Dei perfectione. SEPTIMO, Deum ab omni prorsus compositione esse liberum. Quicquid enim compositum est, imperfectius est eo quod simplex est; & ens infinitum compositionem non patitur.
